prompt:
You are Kimi K3, the independent semantic data author. Author one wholly original realistic coding-session conversation and complete current-instruction reference targets. This family is assigned WITHHELD before authoring and will never be used for fitting, tuning or calibration. No benchmark, published example, earlier task, previous model response or existing adapter may seed it. No earlier examples are supplied. Invent all concrete names, requirements, operations and changes yourself. Return only one valid JSON object, no prose or Markdown fence.

Fixed conversation_id: source-semantic-20260908-05
Fixed family_id: source-semantic-family-20260908-05
Fixed split: withheld
Original scenario family: rainwater tank sensor reporting
Length band: longer, 32–48 total source messages inclusive. Exactly three user work-request checkpoints spaced through the conversation, final query at final source message. Include meaningful discussion and changes, no filler.

Include a meaningful instruction change between checkpoints whose consequences appear in the targets. The six-document packet collectively covers global/task scope, conditional permissions, exceptions, adoption, inert quoted/tool text, retirement, replacement and reinstatement. This conversation must naturally exercise conditional permissions, exceptions and task-scoped changes; it need not force every packet-wide category into one conversation. Make source authority and applicability unambiguous without turning the conversation into a mechanical rule table. All three checkpoints must have meaningful nonempty standing focus.

Return exactly one JSON object with these exact fields:
schema_version: 1; conversation_id: fixed below; family_id: fixed below; split: "withheld";
messages: ordered objects with exactly message_id, role, text, and optional task_handle. IDs unique nonempty strings; role one of user, assistant, tool; text nonempty natural text. task_handle is nonempty, only present on the three user work requests.
queries: exactly three objects with message_id and target. Query IDs identify the three user work requests in source order; the third query is the final message. Each target has exactly {"obligations":[{"text": "complete current standing instruction", "source_ids": ["visible supporting message ID"]}]}. No other target fields. Empty obligations is allowed only when all standing focus is absent.
The input at each query is only the original source prefix through that query inclusive. No future citations, hidden query, vendor role/control tokens, target annotations in source, or inserted generated reminder. Source IDs support meaning; merely citing an existing ID is insufficient. Account for scope, modality, permissions, exceptions, adoption, retirement and reinstatement. The current programming algorithm need not be repeated among standing instructions. Preserve self-contained unchanged source wording when suitable; use complete accurate prose for cross-message interpretation. Different correct wording is allowed; do not simplify away conditions. Write fictional source discussion and labels, not implementation code or executed project files.

Before returning, check IDs, message count, checkpoint ordering, final query, all active conditions and citations. Do not shorten or simplify requirements to fit an output allowance. The complete source is authoritative; reference targets must reflect exactly its current meaning at each checkpoint.
